## grid limit (how fine the 16 m terrain grid honestly carries)
  extrema density = slope reversals per cell along a 4 km line
  0.5 = a reversal at every cell = a checkerboard, not relief
  wavelength m | cells | extrema density | verdict
           32  |   2.0 |           0.380 | REFUSED (below MinWavelengthMetres)
           48  |   3.0 |           0.267 | REFUSED (below MinWavelengthMetres)
           64  |   4.0 |           0.196 | the floor we ship
           80  |   5.0 |           0.157 | usable
          110  |   6.9 |           0.125 | usable
          170  |  10.6 |           0.086 | usable

  azimuthal floor = 96 m (6.0 cells); it fades, it is not a hard floor, because the
  azimuthal wavelength shrinks towards the summit (2 pi d / order)
